question: When MCL's own four-hour impulse has already stopped making proportional progress, does a fresh extreme causal-news pressure state identify greater persistence or convexity after the same TA-owned reversal onset?
null_hypothesis: The extreme-pressure label adds no stable forward MFE, range, holding-value, or drawdown information beyond the identical TA-only onset and time-shifted controls.

frozen_signal.clock: natural causal-news publication timestamps; use only completed five-minute MCL bars
ta_onset: Measure MCL return over the preceding four hours and the last thirty minutes.
The prior four-hour direction is nonzero.
Last-thirty-minute progress in that direction is no greater than the preceding four-hour average hourly progress.
The research direction is opposite the prior MCL price impulse; news cannot choose or reverse it.
news_classifier: The publication is causally available and fresh.
Absolute signed pressure, direction times impact/100 times confidence, is at least 0.80.
Pressure delta, velocity, change label, and expanding innovation residual remain attribution-only secondary fields.

frozen_controls: Identical TA-only onsets without the extreme-pressure label.
Identical price-state evaluation two hours after each publication.
Nonextreme-pressure onsets, separated by prior price direction and UTC session.
A later production candidate must replace the proxy direction with an independently qualified MCL-native TA owner before any execution study.
outcomes: MFE and MAE at 30, 60, and 240 minutes
four-hour high-low range and time to favorable/adverse excursion
persistence versus surrender after TA onset
event overlap, session concentration, and sensitivity to complete-spread and commission assumptions

graduation_requires: Extreme-pressure onsets improve median four-hour favorable excursion and range over the TA-only complement.
Median four-hour adverse excursion and drawdown do not worsen.
The direction and session strata do not reveal one-cluster dependence.
A bootstrap 95% lower bound for the primary favorable-excursion difference is above zero.
The result remains stable when pressure delta and innovation residual are omitted.

discovery_summary.warning: All discovery outcomes were inspected; none count toward prospective graduation.

fail_closed: No historical headline reconstruction or news backfill.
No manipulation claim, headline-sign direction, fixed news percentage, selector, order, position, or profitability clock.
No MCL future or option authority without separate contract, quote, spread, commission, cash/margin, risk, restart, and attribution proof.
Opening Edge v3 live commissioning preempts this study.
